night3_start.name: {name}
night3_start.text: *Friday night. Exhausted, I get home and hang my bag on the chair back.*

night3_start_2.name: {name}
night3_start_2.text: *In the room, lights still off, I flip over the phone I left face down on the desk and turn the screen on.*

night3_faithful_check.name: {name}
night3_faithful_check.text: *Phone light spreads under the dark ceiling. I check the night notifications that have come in.*

night3_faithful_msg_seo_1.name: Seoyeon
night3_faithful_msg_seo_1.text: What you saw in the student council room after school today is really a secret between just the two of us.

night3_faithful_msg_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
night3_faithful_msg_seo_2.text: Next time, too, you can come by the student council room using a lost pen as an excuse. Good night.

night3_faithful_msg_seo_3.name: {name}
night3_faithful_msg_seo_3.text: *The memory of Seoyeon's warm breath brushing my forearm comes back to me. Reading down to the last line and turning off the screen leaves a pleasant warmth behind.*

night3_faithful_msg_yuna_1.name: Yuna
night3_faithful_msg_yuna_1.text: *With a brief buzz, a late-night message arrives from Yuna.* Still awake? Just wondering if you got home safely with the notebook I gave you in the annex.

night3_faithful_msg_yuna_2.name: Yuna
night3_faithful_msg_yuna_2.text: That novel I lent you earlier. I still haven't decided the ending. Once you've read all of it, let's decide it together.

night3_faithful_msg_yuna_2_b.name: {name}
night3_faithful_msg_yuna_2_b.text: *Opening the leather notebook on my desk, I look down at its blank final page. The warmth Yuna left on its cover is still vivid at my fingertips.*

night3_faithful_msg_dain_1.name: Dain
night3_faithful_msg_dain_1.text: Hey. If you're going to ask if my knee's okay, don't settle it in a text. Come ask me yourself tomorrow morning. Haha

night3_faithful_msg_dain_2.name: Dain
night3_faithful_msg_dain_2.text: Thanks for staying beside me the whole time in the gym earlier. Really. See you tomorrow.

night3_faithful_msg_dain_3.name: {name}
night3_faithful_msg_dain_3.text: *A 3-minute gap between the playful "haha" and the next sentence. Dain's touch on my shoulder comes back, vivid.*

night3_dream_1.name: {name}
night3_dream_1.text: *Lying in bed, I pick up my phone again. The closeness of breathing side by side after school still lingers vividly at my fingertips.*

night3_dream_2_b.name: {name}
night3_dream_2_b.text: *I set the phone down by my pillow. Choosing the first thing I'll say when we face each other tomorrow morning, my heart beats slow.*

night3_faithful_reflect_1.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_1.text: *Before I sleep, deep in the gallery, I find a photo of Sojeong from my old school and long-press it.*

night3_faithful_reflect_2_b.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_2_b.text: *A confirmation pops up: "Delete this photo?" My thumb stops above the delete button.*

night3_faithful_reflect_2_c.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_2_c.text: *The graffiti covering Sojeong's desk flashes through my mind, along with the mornings I turned away.*

night3_faithful_reflect_2_d.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_2_d.text: *I tap Cancel on the confirmation. Deleting one photo won't make the fact that I ran away back then disappear.*

night3_faithful_reflect_3.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_3.text: *Instead of the delete button, I tap Move and put the photo in a new folder called 'Record'.*

night3_faithful_reflect_3_b.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_3_b.text: *The only way to make up for the apology I never gave Sojeong is to be honest with the person beside me now.*

night3_faithful_reflect_4.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_4.text: *Inside the new folder, one photo settles quietly into place.*

night3_dream_3.name: {name}
night3_dream_3.text: *I close the gallery and set tomorrow's alarm. The warmth that brushed me during the day keeps sleep from coming easily.*

night3_dream_seo_bonus.name: {name}
night3_dream_seo_bonus.text: *The moment I close my eyes, the sunset light in the student council room comes first, Seoyeon's hot forehead against my forearm, and the ribbon at her collar, slightly undone.*

night3_dream_yuna_bonus.name: {name}
night3_dream_yuna_bonus.text: *The moment I close my eyes, in the quiet air of the annex, I feel Yuna pull my palm onto her cheek, cool and flushed at once.*

night3_dream_dain_bonus.name: {name}
night3_dream_dain_bonus.text: *The moment I close my eyes, I feel Dain on the empty gym bench, clutching the hem of my shirt and pressing into my chest, her breath short.*

night3_cheat_msg_2.name: Seoyeon
night3_cheat_msg_2.text: Can't you smile like that only for me, not for Dain and Yuna?

night3_cheat_msg_3_b.name: Seoyeon
night3_cheat_msg_3_b.text: *In Seoyeon's chat, the "typing" indicator blinks for a long while before stopping with a single short line.* Sorry. Forget what I just sent.

night3_cheat_msg_4.name: Yuna
night3_cheat_msg_4.text: You weighing us against each other—I knew all along from the start.

night3_cheat_msg_4_b.name: Yuna
night3_cheat_msg_4_b.text: I can't stand being lined up as one of your options. The others can't either.

night3_cheat_msg_5.name: Yuna
night3_cheat_msg_5.text: Tomorrow, decide for sure which one person you're going to, and come.

night3_cheat_msg_6.name: Yuna
night3_cheat_msg_6.text: Don't avoid my eyes. Promise me just that.

night3_cheat_msg_dain_1.name: Dain
night3_cheat_msg_dain_1.text: Haha. That thing at lunch earlier. I wish it had just been a joke to tease me.

night3_cheat_msg_7.name: Yuna
night3_cheat_msg_7.text: I know you're reading this without replying. Tomorrow morning, I'm catching you first. *Lighting up the dark room, Yuna's final message holds my gaze fast.*

night3_nightmare_1.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_1.text: *I lie down in the dark room, yet my heart pounds too hard to shut my eyes. Only the cool glow of the screen lights my palm.*

night3_nightmare_2_b.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_2_b.text: *With a trembling thumb, I reopen Seoyeon's chat. Over the line where she set down all her pride—"Please. I'm begging you"—her tear-wet eyes overlap just as a new message pops up.*

night3_nightmare_3.name: Seoyeon
night3_nightmare_3.text: I'm not pressing you to give me an answer tonight. Just don't run away from me tomorrow.

night3_nightmare_3_b.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_3_b.text: *Closing the chat, I open Yuna's window, where the "Read" mark I left behind sits cold on the screen.*

night3_nightmare_4.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_4.text: *"Don't avoid my eyes. Promise me just that." Beyond the short message bubble, Yuna's piercing crimson eyes rise vividly in the dark.*

night3_nightmare_4_b.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_4_b.text: *At the very bottom, Dain's chat holds only a single line hanging alone behind the casual laugh she tacked on.*

night3_nightmare_5.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_5.text: *"I wish it had just been a joke to tease me." Since the sun went down, not one more message has come from Dain.*

night3_nightmare_6.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_6.text: *I open the three chats in turn, type replies that sound like excuses, then erase every one of them.*

night3_nightmare_choice.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_choice.text: *Once this long, heavy night passes and day breaks, whom should I go see first to tell the truth?*
choices: Decide to talk to Seoyeon first
Decide to talk to Yuna first
Decide to talk to Dain first

night3_nightmare_seo.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_seo.text: *In Seoyeon's text box I type "Sorry. Tomorrow morning I'll see you face to face first and tell you," then set my shaking thumb on Send.*

night3_nightmare_yuna.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_yuna.text: *After typing "Tomorrow I won't avoid you at all—I'll come to you first" into Yuna's input bar, the cursor blinks rapidly past the final letter.*

night3_nightmare_dain.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_dain.text: *In Dain's text box I type "Sorry I left you to think it through alone. I'll tell you first thing tomorrow morning." The tip of my thumb freezes over the send icon.*

night3_nightmare_end.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_end.text: *The one last sentence left in the text box is still unsent.*

night3_nightmare_end_3.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_end_3.text: *Still awake past three in the morning, I close the messaging app and rest my thumb on Sojeong's photo in the gallery.*

night3_cheat_reflect_2.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_2.text: *In the group photo, Sojeong looks faintly toward the camera, while beside her I'm quietly averting my eyes from an uncomfortable spot, just like back then.*

night3_cheat_reflect_3_c.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_3_c.text: *I scroll slowly down the message list. Beside each name left in the wake of my overlapping plans sits a different wound.*

night3_cheat_reflect_3_d.name: Minsu
night3_cheat_reflect_3_d.text: *Just then, a short message from Minsu pops up at the top of the screen.* Putting it off because you're scared doesn't make it go away on its own.

night3_cheat_reflect_3_e.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_3_e.text: *Calmly, I reread each open chat from the very first line. This time, I don't rush to close a single window.*

night3_cheat_reflect_5.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_5.text: *I lift my thumb from Send and set the phone face down. Instead of smoothing things over with a few typed words, I'll face them directly once morning comes.*

night3_nightmare_end_4.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_end_4.text: *I rename the dawn alarm to "Don't run. Answer."*

night3_end.name: {name}
night3_end.text: *Beyond the dark outside the window, Friday night slowly draws to a close. Setting my phone face down beside my pillow, I close my eyes toward the coming weekend morning.*

forced_violation_day3_after_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
forced_violation_day3_after_seoyeon.text: *After a cold silence, Seoyeon speaks in an ice-cold voice.* Don't think you can call what you just did a mistake and wave it off like it never happened. For a while, don't come near me, and don't contact me.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day3_seoyeon_apologize.name: Seoyeon
forced_violation_day3_seoyeon_apologize.text: *Seoyeon's face doesn't ease at all.* I heard the apology. That doesn't erase the fact that you crossed the line. Like I said, don't contact me for a while.

forced_violation_day3_seoyeon_excuse.name: Seoyeon
forced_violation_day3_seoyeon_excuse.text: *Seoyeon cuts me off, firm.* A misunderstanding? From the moment I clearly said no, it can't be a misunderstanding. Don't say one more word.

forced_violation_day3_after_yuna.name: Yuna
forced_violation_day3_after_yuna.text: *Yuna takes a step back and drags in a rough breath.* I said I didn't want it, and you ignored me all the way to the end. I don't even want to see your face right now, so don't contact me anymore.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day3_yuna_apologize.name: Yuna
forced_violation_day3_yuna_apologize.text: *After a long silence, Yuna answers, low.* One apology doesn't make what just happened disappear. Go back now.

forced_violation_day3_yuna_excuse.name: Yuna
forced_violation_day3_yuna_excuse.text: *Yuna turns her head without even hearing my excuse through.* I clearly said no. This isn't something you can cover with an excuse.

forced_violation_day3_after_dain.name: Dain
forced_violation_day3_after_dain.text: *The smile leaves Dain's face completely. Her stiff voice drops low.* You don't get to pass this off as a joke. I said no, and you crossed the line anyway. I am not letting that go.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day3_dain_apologize.name: Dain
forced_violation_day3_dain_apologize.text: *Only after a long while does Dain speak, cold.* I heard the apology. Today's talk ends here. Whether we see each other again is for me to decide.

forced_violation_day3_dain_excuse.name: Dain
forced_violation_day3_dain_excuse.text: *Dain's voice turns rough and sharp.* Don't hide behind a cowardly excuse. I told you not to, and you're the one who pushed it.

forced_violation_day3_after_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
forced_violation_day3_after_teacher.text: *The homeroom teacher steps back from where she stands, her face set.* What you just said and did clearly crossed a line. Don't come any closer. I'll handle this by school rules and procedure.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day3_teacher_apologize.name: Homeroom Teacher
forced_violation_day3_teacher_apologize.text: *The homeroom teacher takes a short breath and speaks.* I'll log the apology. But the official procedure will go ahead as is, so don't say any more. Go back.

forced_violation_day3_teacher_excuse.name: Homeroom Teacher
forced_violation_day3_teacher_excuse.text: *The homeroom teacher cuts off the explanation, cold.* This isn't a situation you can smooth over with a clumsy excuse. Keep your distance right now and go back to the classroom.

forced_violation_day3_after_haeun.name: Haeun
forced_violation_day3_after_haeun.text: *Haeun steps back, her face gone pale, and clutches her student council bracelet.* Please don't come any closer. I'm going to the faculty office right now to call a teacher.
choices: Admit the wrongdoing and keep my distance.

forced_violation_day3_haeun_apologize.name: Haeun
forced_violation_day3_haeun_apologize.text: *Haeun doesn't even answer. She backs toward the faculty office, watching to be sure I don't follow.*

forced_violation_day3_haeun_excuse.name: Haeun
forced_violation_day3_haeun_excuse.text: This isn't a misunderstanding. Please don't follow me. *Keeping her distance, Haeun hurriedly opens the faculty office door and goes in.*

forced_violation_day3_after_nurse.name: School Nurse
forced_violation_day3_after_nurse.text: *The easy smile vanishes completely from the school nurse's face.* From now on, keep a clear distance. I'll record what you just did in the counseling log and officially notify the office in charge.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day3_nurse_apologize.name: School Nurse
forced_violation_day3_nurse_apologize.text: *The school nurse closes the chart and answers, firm.* I'll hear the apology. Even so, the official record and the report will go through by procedure. Today's session ends here.

forced_violation_day3_nurse_excuse.name: School Nurse
forced_violation_day3_nurse_excuse.text: *The school nurse's voice drops, cold.* Do you think dressing it up as a misunderstanding changes what just happened? I clearly refused, and you ignored that.
